name: @fdpm-plugins/academic-paper-v0-4-1
description: Academic paper plugin v0.4.1 — side-by-side registration of profile:academic-paper:0.4.1 alongside the v0.3 plugin. Adds two transitive cycle-detection rules (Claim.supersededBy + Quotation.translatedFrom) on top of v0.3's 33 rules, bringing the typed-graph integrity layer to parity with the rev3 SHACL mirror. Primitives prefixed `acad041:` to avoid collision with v0.3's `acad:`.
